background_notes.justification: The maximum distance satisfies separation, symmetry and the triangle inequality by the corresponding factor properties. Its open balls are products of factor balls, so it induces the product topology. Both Euclidean factors have countable bases, including the singleton case n=0; every open product-space set is a countable union of basic open rectangles. This identifies its Borel sigma algebra with the product Borel sigma algebra. No measurability of F itself is needed.
